site.title: AgroTico Smart
site.description: Costa Rican innovation transforming the countryside

hero.title: AgroTico Smart
hero.content:
Costa Rican innovation transforming the countryside. We are a precision agriculture platform created by students from Don Bosco Technical Professional College, to address the challenges faced by Costa Rican farmers.

We unite education, technology and social impact to build a more sustainable future. 🌱🇨🇷

quote.content: AgroTico Smart is an innovative solution that brings technology to the field. With its focus on precision agriculture, it represents the talent and vision of Costa Rican youth to transform the way we produce food.

demo.title: Dashboard
demo.content: Explore our data dashboard and discover how AgroTico Smart can help you make precise decisions for your farm, optimizing resources and increasing productivity.
